question: Using the activity log table, compute the total number of unique user sessions where each web page appears as either a landing page (the first page visited in a session based on timestamp) or an exit page (the last page visited in a session based on timestamp), or both. Count each session only once per page even if the page serves as both landing and exit for that session.
sql:
-- Find unique (session, path) pairs where path is either a landing or exit page
WITH distinct_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT stamp, session, action, option, path, search_type
    FROM activity_log
),
session_times AS (
    SELECT session,
           MIN(stamp) as min_stamp,
           MAX(stamp) as max_stamp
    FROM distinct_events
    GROUP BY session
),
landing_pages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT de.session, de.path
    FROM distinct_events de
    JOIN session_times st ON de.session = st.session
    WHERE de.stamp = st.min_stamp
),
exit_pages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT de.session, de.path
    FROM distinct_events de
    JOIN session_times st ON de.session = st.session
    WHERE de.stamp = st.max_stamp
),
all_page_sessions AS (
    SELECT session, path FROM landing_pages
    UNION ALL
    SELECT session, path FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT path, COUNT(DISTINCT session) as unique_sessions
FROM all_page_sessions
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY unique_sessions DESC, path
